This analysis is crucial in understanding the efficacy of these testing kits, particularly during a pandemic where rapid and accurate diagnosis is paramount.

The study's strengths are evident in its comprehensive coverage of literature reviews on lateral flow immunoassays (LFIAs) and its focused approach on SARS-CoV-2 virus testing.
